annotations.title: Rehearse the import into its closed project

description: Restores the analyzed source into the project's own stack, which stays closed: no public address, no outbound network, no cron launches, no Functions and no SMTP. Then the checks run. The import must be analyzed with no blocker, within 24 hours of its start. Requires owner or maintainer access, or a project key with project:write.
